how: We read the website of every San Antonio wedding photographer listed on Lazo (78 listings, 64 sites reachable) and set aside the ones that are not really in the wedding business: commercial, Airbnb and headshot photographers, a portrait studio, a studio page that only recruits staff, an Austin-based photographer, a site still showing template placeholder text, and keyword-stuffed pages with nothing to read. What is left is a shortlist of vendors who say clearly what they do, show their work, and tell you how they work. Verified Lazo vendors come first. Nobody paid to be here, and this is not a ranking: Lazo ranks only on reviews from couples who booked.
ask: Our ceremony is outdoors in the Hill Country heat. How do you handle harsh midday light, and when do you want portraits scheduled?
Can I see a full wedding gallery, not just highlights, and how long until the finished gallery is delivered?
Is a second photographer and an engagement session included, or are those add-ons?

picks.name: John G Photography LLC
picks.blurb: John found his passion in wedding photography in 2018 and now shoots elopements, portraits and weddings full time from San Antonio in a bold, timeless photojournalistic style. He tells you what to expect: most couples invest around $4,500 for full-day coverage. Serves New Braunfels and San Antonio.

picks.name: Sarah Thompson Photography
picks.blurb: Light and airy wedding photography from Sarah Thompson, a San Antonio photographer who promises a fun, supportive, stress-free experience and admits she will be dancing at your reception. Attention to detail starts at the consultation, where she takes notes on every part of the day. Based in San Antonio, travels throughout Texas.

picks.name: Witte Idea
picks.blurb: Witte Idea is a San Marcos couple who met in a college art class and started collaborating on photo and video projects; the wedding business began with videography and grew to both. Candid and creative, with wedding day packages they describe as totally customizable.

picks.name: Allison Jeffers Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Allison Jeffers photographs weddings in Fredericksburg and San Antonio in a style she calls joyful, timeless and romantic, serving all of South and Central Texas. Her pitch is real candid moments, mom crying in the front row, the groom's first look, alongside portraits that find your best angles.

picks.name: Marvin Anthony Wedding Photography
picks.blurb: Marvin Jimenez was born and raised in San Antonio and picked up a camera in 2001. Marvin Anthony Photography lays out what a package includes: a planning consultation, an edited online gallery with unlimited downloads, and a one to three week turnaround, starting from four hours of coverage.

picks.name: Aerostar Photography
picks.blurb: Diego of Aerostar Photography brings a photojournalistic touch to San Antonio weddings and describes himself as a friend who dances and laughs with you. The package is simple: unlimited coverage with two skilled photographers and an engagement session included.

picks.name: Lois M Photography
picks.blurb: Editorial, artful wedding photography rooted in presence, not performance. Lois Macomber believes a gallery feels most alive when you forget the camera, and she builds the experience around that. Based in San Antonio, serving couples across Texas and select destinations worldwide.

picks.name: Shelly Beck Photography
picks.blurb: Shelly Beck Photography in Boerne shoots luxury wedding photography for adventurous, fearless couples who want timeless, vibrant images, with a team behind the lens. The site lists the small print of the studio's personality, laughing loudly, dancing, and keeping it real with no AI.

picks.name: Solarshot Weddings - Photography And Videography
picks.blurb: Solarshot Weddings is a San Antonio team of photographers and videographers working in a documentary style, so one crew covers stills and film. Dates are limited and booked first come, first served; package details come by inquiry.

picks.name: Philip Thomas Photography
picks.blurb: Philip Thomas met his wife working on a cruise ship, moved to San Antonio in 2006 and has shot candid, documentary weddings here ever since, with Austin and Houston in range. He says his 2027 dates are filling fast; enter your date on the site and he sends pricing.

picks.name: Ellah Laurenn Photography
tags: options for a range of budgets
picks.blurb: Ellah Laurenn is a fine art wedding and portrait photographer in San Antonio who finished a bachelor's and master's in communication arts by age 20 and describes her creativity as a calling. Serves Austin and destinations worldwide, with service options designed for a variety of needs and budgets.

picks.name: BRANDI MORGAN PHOTOGRAPHY LLC
picks.blurb: Brandi Morgan prints her starting prices: weddings from $2,397 and elopements from $1,497, with portraits and headshots on the same page. A San Antonio lifestyle photographer serving South Texas and beyond who describes herself as a creative, a mom and a travel junkie.
